question_pt: Quais diagnosticos tiveram maior crescimento percentual de internacoes do periodo 2015-2019 para 2020-2023?
sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS total_2015_2019 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2015 AND 2019 GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC" AS cid, COUNT(*) AS total_2020_2023 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023 GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, p1.total_2015_2019, p2.total_2020_2023, ROUND((p2.total_2020_2023 - p1.total_2015_2019) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p1.total_2015_2019, 0), 2) AS crescimento_percentual FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1.cid = p2.cid JOIN cid c ON p1.cid = c."CID" WHERE p1.total_2015_2019 >= 1000 ORDER BY crescimento_percentual DESC LIMIT 10
